title: 第11章 胡同杀机第12章 杀戮之剑与诡异妖刀
content_zh:
乌云笼罩着荒城内外，大雨倾盆而下。
胡同之中，十数道黑衣身影，在雨幕之中激荡起一股股元力波动。
“等了你三年，你活着真是一件让人兴奋的事，能够亲手宰了你，我今晚恐怕会高兴得睡不着！”
一道高大的身影笼罩在黑衣里面，豆粒大的雨水哗啦啦地落下，却在他的周身顷刻化成烟雾，一股炙热的元力从他体内弥漫而出。
余烬脱掉黑袍上的帽子，少年那张越发棱角分明的脸庞，在雨水之中显得格外冷冽，随手一抬，刀鞘脱手以惊人的速度破开雨幕，如同一条毒蛇冲向那为首的高大黑影！
雨声中传来一道不屑的冷哼，高大黑影抬起手掌，虚空一爪强横的元力喷吐而出，将爆裂而来的刀鞘控制在手心之前！
高大黑影大喝一声，“给我将他剁成肉泥！”
随着话音落下，胡同内所有的黑衣人同时扑出，此起彼伏的元力波动充斥在全场。
余烬冷冷地看着这一幕，一动不动。
直到当先的那名黑衣人，跃到身前，凌空拔剑向着他斩下，余烬才缓缓递出一刀，也就在同一个瞬间，一圈黑色的火焰纹路神秘地浮现在余烬挥刀的手臂之上。
刀剑相碰，那名黑衣人的瞳孔突然剧烈收缩，一股从未感受过的恐怖怪力席卷他的整个身躯！
长剑应声断成无数碎片，黑衣人像是受到爆裂冲击，如同炮弹一般狠狠倒射回去！
余烬一言不发，眼神升起一股从未有过的淡漠感，就像是杀神附体，一人一刀迎向雨幕之中的黑衣人，手起刀落的每个瞬间，鲜红色的血液染红了雨幕…
踏踏踏！
脚掌在地面连踩，泥水飞溅，刚猛无比的拳头携裹着元力气流，从暗处一拳砸出，直轰余烬的太阳穴而去！
在杀戮之中的余烬，几乎是凭借着本能的条件反射，侧过头颅，那拳锋从面门上擦过，像是钝石砸来让他得脸上火辣辣地生痛！
“给我死！”
高大黑影发出暴喝，以极为快速的反应挥出第二拳，直轰余烬腹部而去，可下一秒他惊骇无比地收拳，身影暴退！
一道刀光紧随而至，几乎是贴着他的身躯划过！
嘶啦！

高大黑影腹部的衣衫被刀光撕裂，里面穿着的软甲也被撕出一道口子，一条浅浅的血痕浮现……
“你的战力远超一境，果然余氏那群废物还是靠不住，但你今天还是要死！”高大黑影深吸了一口气，一股更加强横的元力波动从体内爆发！
“果然是三境……不过应该只是三境前期。”余烬低语，看了眼手中的长刀，忽然做了一个让人匪夷所思的动作。
他手掌一松，将长刀丢在了地上，平静地看着对面气势不断上涨的黑影。
高大黑影先是一愣，然后轻蔑一笑，“这就放弃了？”
“借来的刀，用着不顺手。”余烬缓缓抬头，一步踏出！
轰！
雨幕中一声如同音爆般的炸响，余烬的身形化作连串幻影冲向黑衣人！
黑衣人眼神一沉，体内元力滚滚，大步向前一拳轰出！
嘭！
俩人接触的瞬间，黑衣人一拳砸在余烬的胸膛之上，刚猛无比的拳力倾泻而出，“你我境界之间有着两个大境界的差距，与我硬碰硬，寻死之道罢了！”
黑衣人有着绝对的自信和实力，哪怕一开始惊讶于余烬的战力，可终究到底还是三境对战一境！
但他一拳砸出之后，他便察觉到了不对劲，对面的余烬纹丝不动，那双淡漠到骨子里的黑眸，正平静地看着他。
他下意识低头，忽然脱口而出，“糟糕！”
黑衣人脑海中只来得及划过这个念头，脸上便突然挨了一记暴拳！
轰一声巨响！
content_en:
Dark clouds enveloped the inside and outside of the deserted city, and heavy rain poured down.
In the alley, dozens of black-clothed figures stirred up waves of energy in the rain.
"I've been waiting for you for three years. It's really exciting to have you alive. To be able to kill you with my own hands, I'm afraid I'll be too happy to sleep tonight!"
A tall figure shrouded in black clothes, raindrops as big as beans fell, but instantly turned into smoke around him, and a hot energy filled the air from his body.
Yi Yan took off the hat on his black robe, and the boy's increasingly angular face looked particularly cold in the rain. He raised his hand casually, and the scabbard broke through the rain curtain at an alarming speed, like a poisonous snake rushing towards the tall black figure at the head!
There was a disdainful snort in the sound of rain. The tall black figure raised his palm, and a powerful claw of energy spurted out from the void, controlling the exploding scabbard in front of the palm of his hand!
The tall black figure shouted, "Chop him into pieces!"
As the words fell, all the men in black in the alley rushed out at the same time, and one after another fluctuations of Yuanli filled the whole place.
Ember watched this scene coldly, motionless.
It wasn't until the man in black in front of him jumped in front of him, drew his sword in the air and slashed at him, that Yi Yan slowly handed out a knife. At the same moment, a circle of black flame lines mysteriously appeared on Yi Yi's sword-wielding arm.
When the swords collided, the man in black's pupils suddenly shrank violently, and a terrifying force that he had never felt before swept through his entire body!
The long sword broke into countless pieces, and the figure in black seemed to be hit by the explosion, and was shot back like a cannonball!
Yi Yan said nothing, and there was a sense of indifference in his eyes that he had never seen before, as if he was possessed by the god of death. He faced the man in black in the rain with one knife. Every moment when he raised the knife and lowered it, the bright red blood stained the rain curtain...
Tap tap tap!
The soles of his feet repeatedly stepped on the ground, causing mud and water to splash. His extremely fierce fist, wrapped in the energy flow, punched out from the darkness and hit Yi Yan's temple!
In the midst of the killing, Ember turned his head sideways almost relying on instinctive conditioned reflexes, and the fist grazed his face, like a blunt stone hitting him, causing his face to burn with pain!
"Die!"
The tall black figure shouted violently, and with extremely quick reaction, he threw a second punch, which hit Ember's abdomen directly. However, the next second he withdrew his fist in horror, and the figure retreated violently!
A ray of sword light followed closely, almost passing through his body!
Hiss!
The clothes on the abdomen of the tall black figure were torn apart by the light of the knife, and the soft armor worn underneath was also torn out, and a shallow blood stain appeared...
"Your combat power is far beyond the first level. Sure enough, those trash guys from the Yu family are still unreliable, but you are still going to die today!" The tall black figure took a deep breath, and an even more powerful wave of Yuan Power erupted from his body!
"It is indeed the third realm...but it should only be the early stage of the three realms." Yi Yan whispered, glanced at the long knife in his hand, and suddenly made an incredible move.
He loosened his grip, dropped the long knife on the ground, and calmly looked at the growing black figure on the opposite side.
The tall black figure was stunned for a moment, then smiled contemptuously, "You're giving up now?"
"The borrowed knife is not easy to use." Yi Yan slowly raised his head and took a step forward!
boom!
There was an explosion like a sonic boom in the rain curtain, and Ember's figure turned into a series of phantoms and rushed towards the man in black!
The man in black's eyes darkened, his energy surged in his body, he strode forward and punched out!
Bang!
The moment the two people came into contact, the man in black punched Yu Yan's chest, and the extremely fierce punch force poured out, "There is a huge gap between your realm and mine. You are just seeking death if you fight me head-on!"
The man in black has absolute confidence and strength. Even though he was surprised at the fighting power of Ember at first, in the end it was still three realms versus one realm!
But after he punched out, he realized something was wrong, and heThe embers on his face were motionless, and those black eyes that were indifferent to the core were looking at him calmly.
He lowered his head subconsciously and suddenly blurted out, "Oops!"
The man in black only had time to cross this thought in his mind before he suddenly received a violent punch in the face!
A loud bang!
